hypotheses.rule: M-107: pre-register before any backtest; a strategy with no registered hypothesis cannot be promoted past CANDIDATE.

known_gaps: bt_backtest_trades holds ~32.7M rows and is NOT scanned here; full scans time out. Pre-aggregate by (strategy, symbol, class, month) first.
Prior backtests are evidence, not verdicts: without a trade log or a timing-null price series they cannot be re-scored by the tribunal.
Costs are only trusted when the source states them; recomputed numbers are gross and labelled cost_basis=unknown.
RECOVERY_PROTOCOL.MD does not exist in this repo (referenced only from WIRED_IN prompts and .kilo worktrees).
Forward/live rows remain the only inputs to the kill tribunal; this registry never promotes anything on its own.
